name: Probono Form Basic
author: probonodesign

sections.description:
Probono Form is a contact form plugin designed and developed specifically for Japanese websites. Create a fully functional contact form with just a few clicks.

Why Choose Probono Form

  • Made in Japan – Developed by Japanese developers who understand Japanese web forms
  • 32 Free Features – Comprehensive free feature set for contact forms
  • Japanese Optimized – Auto-address lookup, furigana generation, honorific support
  • Lightweight & Fast – Minimal code for optimal performance

Free Features (32 features)

Form Basics (8 features)
Unlimited form creation, form duplication, form deletion (single/bulk), form name editing, 12 field types (pf1-pf12), required field settings, real-time preview, shortcode output

Confirmation Screen (5 features)
Confirmation screen ON/OFF, title customization, message customization, button text editing, success/error messages

Email Functions (6 features)
Admin notification email, subject customization, CC settings, BCC settings, auto-reply email, reply template selection

Style Settings (5 features)
Form border ON/OFF, 5 color themes, button shape options, button fill options, font size options

Japanese Features (3 features)
Postal code to address auto-fill (zipcloud API), furigana auto-generation, honorific auto-append

Spam Protection (2 features)
Honeypot field, submission time check

Other (3 features)
Responsive design, loading spinner, double-submit prevention

Pro Version

For advanced features including AI-powered form assistance, booking forms, advanced Japanese features, and more, a separate Pro plugin is available at https://form.prbn.org

External services

This plugin connects to the zipcloud API to retrieve address information from Japanese postal codes. It is used to automatically fill in the address field when a user enters a postal code in the form.

The postal code entered by the user is sent to the zipcloud API only when the postal code field is used and the user inputs a value.

This service is provided by IBS Co., Ltd.:
– Service URL: https://zipcloud.ibsnet.co.jp
– Terms of service: https://zipcloud.ibsnet.co.jp/rule/api
– Privacy policy: https://zipcloud.ibsnet.co.jp/policy
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin and upload the ZIP file
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins list
  3. Open the Probono Form menu in the admin dashboard
  4. Create a new form and insert the shortcode into your page
sections.faq:
Is this for Japanese websites?

Yes. Probono Form is designed and optimized for Japanese websites. It includes features like postal code to address lookup and furigana generation.

Is it Made in Japan?

Yes. Probono Form is developed in Japan by Japanese developers.

Can I use it with other form plugins?

Yes. Probono Form works independently and does not conflict with other form plugins.

Does it work with any WordPress theme?

Yes. It works with any standard WordPress theme.

How many forms can I create?

Unlimited. There is no limit on the number of forms.

Does this plugin collect user data?

This plugin does not collect user data. It only connects to zipcloud API for postal code lookup when users enter postal codes.
